overview: You are trying to enjoy a quiet pint in the pub but a patron and his son seemingly have a problem with your demeanour ...

title: Saving Spoonie
overview: Spoonie, the spoon-billed sandpiper, would have long since gone extinct without Dr. Christoph Zöckler and a tight-knit group of international ornithologists. As if that weren’t bad enough, the migration route of this sparrow-sized wading bird—with its peculiar spoon-shaped bill—runs from Russia through North Korea and China all the way to Myanmar, passing through several of the world’s crisis regions of the past decade. The work of the task force is therefore also a political challenge. It requires diplomatic sensitivity in coordinating with the countries along the flyway. In the tragicomic story of Spoonie’s fate, the struggle for threatened biodiversity in an increasingly fragile world is reflected.

title: AEW x NJPW x CMLL x Stardom Present Forbidden Door 2026
overview: The 2026 Forbidden Door was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event and supershow co-produced by the American promotion All Elite Wrestling (AEW), Mexican promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) and the Japanese promotions New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) and World Wonder Ring Stardom (Stardom). It was the fifth annual Forbidden Door event and took place on June 28, 2026 at SAP Center at San Jose in San Jose, California, USA.

title: The Loud House: European Adventure
overview: The Louds are headed to Europe, where they'll attend a knighting ceremony in London, search for the world's best pizza in Italy, spend a night in a creepy castle in Transylvania, ski the Swiss alps, and time-travel to ancient Greece!

title: The Genesis Project
overview: For their term project, five psychology students decide to study serial killers to learn what turns a normal person, into a cold-blooded murderer. With the knowledge they gain, they attempt to capture the killer stalking their town.

title: Untitled Coming of Age Film
overview: Plot unknown.

title: Jawaak
overview: Set against a community backdrop, events unfold around personal conflict and shifting relationships. As tensions rise, individuals are forced to confront difficult choices. The outcome is shaped by loyalty, pressure, and consequence.
trailerName: Jawaak (Official Trailer) | Neeru Bajwa | New Punjabi Movie 2026 | In Cinemas 8th May 2026

title: The Selling Stage
overview: At the end of a twenty-five-year career, LuFisto confronts the cost of chasing a dream that asked for everything and gave back less than promised.

title: Krishnavataram Part 1: The Heart (Hridayam)
overview: An epic devotional narrative that reimagines the journey of Lord Krishna, tracing his path from Dwarka to Kurukshetra after parting ways with Radha. As his journey unfolds, it explores his connection with people, his layered personality, and the lessons he imparts about love and life.
trailerName: Krishnavataram Part 1: The Heart (Hridayam) | Official Trailer

title: Мой папа — медведь 2
overview: A grown-up Masha decides to arrange a personal life for her father, Misha, which leads to a fight with her father, who pries into matters that don't concern her. Masha, upset with her father, runs away into the forest and ends up with a little bear cub whose parents were kidnapped by poachers. Masha's adventures begin, during which she realizes how difficult it is to be a parent, and most importantly, how difficult it is to raise children.

title: Boney M: Disco. Macht. Legende.
overview: The global success of disco legends Boney M. has left a lasting impact. But who are the people behind the songs? And what does their success have to do with a recording studio in Offenbach?

title: The Devil Wears Prada 2 Red Carpet World Premiere
overview: Get ready for couture, cameras, and cast moments as Disney+ and Hulu livestream the The Devil Wears Prada 2 world premiere from New York City’s Lincoln Center. Streaming live to subscribers worldwide, the event offers a rare, front‑row view as it unfolds in America’s fashion capital. From red carpet arrivals to behind‑the‑scenes interviews, it’s an inside look at one of the most glamorous nights of the year, and the perfect kickoff to the film’s theatrical debut.

title: Nosebleed
overview: A psycho-sexual queer thriller which blends fantasy and reality against a backdrop of the deep, dark web; told through the eyes of a prospective serial killer.

title: Photo Negative
overview: A struggling forensic photographer develops an unhealthy business relationship with a wealthy couple whose requests grow increasingly sinister.

title: Rod Quantock Comedy Warrior
overview: This feature documentary charts Rod Quantock’s five-decade career and his tireless efforts to communicate the perils of neoliberalism and the urgency of climate change through humour. His journey illustrates the building of the thriving comedy landscape we take for granted today, showcasing a man who has remained steadfast in his pursuit of truth in an hilarious fashion.

title: The Lion Queen
overview: You’ve seen her face on the cover of countless newspapers. Now step into the larger-than-life world and surprising true story of a true New York original — socialite Jocelyne Wildenstein, a.k.a. “The Lion Queen.”

title: Wellness Retreat
overview: A successful business woman seeks out a wellness retreat to improve her sleep. When she finds the location is actually a seedy motel, her exhaustion takes the lead and she chooses to stay the night, despite her better judgment.

title: Nadar em Aquários
overview: Alone at a seaside inn on a beach in southern Brazil, Ícaro and Caio wake to the same morning over and over again, condemned to relive it forever.

title: Airport BLVD
overview: In the transforming streets of East Austin, Xavier watches his community, friendships, and sense of home disappear. As the city evolves around him, Airport BLVD becomes a soulful, romantic, and bittersweet love letter to a city old and new.

title: Bang My Box: The Robin Byrd Story
overview: Robin Byrd pioneered NYC public access with her cult sex-positive call-in show.  Now the larger-than-life 70-year-old champion of free speech, queer visibility, and safe sex reflects on her unique legacy and her hidden, decades-long marriage behind the scenes.

title: threeASFOUR: Full Circle
overview: Follows avant-garde NYC designers Gabi Asfour, Angela Donhauser, and Adi Gil and their singular "couture-on-the-street" designs; highlighting fashion as a radical act of collaboration shaped by war, identity, and hope.

title: Alicia Keys: Girl From Hell’s Kitchen
overview: Alicia Keys reflects on her childhood growing up in Manhattan's Hell's Kitchen and the journey that led her from the gritty streets of 90s New York to the Broadway stage in Tribeca.

title: We Will Haunt Your Archive
overview: December 2, 2023. A queer protest erupts in San Francisco in solidarity with Palestine. The film situates this action within the longer history of ACT UP’s activism during the AIDS crisis. It explores glitch as a radical feminist tactic for resisting contemporary regimes of surveillance and silencing.

title: The Terror: Devil In Silver
overview: Wrongfully committed to a psychiatric hospital, one man must survive patients, doctors with dark secrets… and something far more sinister.  The Terror: Devil in Silver premieres May 7 on AMC+ and Shudder.

title: Here I'm Alive
overview: One night. One city. Migrants, sex workers and dreamers hustle New York's digital underbelly in this neo-realist urban epic driven by underground rap and spiritual jazz. Raw, unforgettable and unmistakably New York.

title: Mumford & Sons: The House Band
overview: Mumford & Sons invite the camera onto the train for one of the most purely pleasurable concert docs in years. Featuring Noah Kahan, Darius Rucker, Lainey Wilson, Maggie Rogers, and several other special guests along for the ride, the journey captures the intimacy and camaraderie between all the performers both onstage and off.

title: Noga
overview: Fearless alternative pop singer Noga Erez is on the brink of superstardom with a unique, captivating sound and a major studio album on the way. But when war erupts and cracks appear in her relationship, Noga must redefine her role as an artist on a global stage.

title: The Symphony of Dance
overview: A behind-the-scenes glimpse at a marathon of performances by Dancing with the Stars’ Derek and Hayley Hough becomes something entirely different when Hayley is forced to fight for her life following a shocking health crisis.

title: Trinity: The Story of The LOX
overview: Travel through time and reflect on the genesis, journey, and brotherhood of the multidimensional rap trio from Yonkers, The LOX.

title: Frampton
overview: Follows a rock icon who lost everything and fought his way back, again and again.

title: Headshot
overview: When two horribly unemployed recent grads discover on LinkedIn that their least favorite person on the planet is successful and (GOD FORBID) thriving, they try to replicate her perfect headshot to get hired.

title: NEOT: The Movie
overview: The long-awaited finale to NEOT! Will the cast finally make a funny joke? Will Mappy return again? And will the sloppily constructed lore finally coalesce into something somewhat coherent? There's only one way to find out!

title: Kyle and Eric's Quest for the Golden Bong
overview: Two stoners go on an epic journey, filled with trials and challanges after finding a scroll that tells of a legendary lost artifact

title: Mario
overview: Ronald Reagan’s America sets the stage for Mario Cuomo, the son of Italian immigrants who rose to become Governor of New York and, in his defining 1984 DNC speech, offered a powerful vision of leadership rooted in compassion.

title: Beyond the Game: Samurai 2026 WORLD BASEBALL CLASSIC
overview: The pressure of glory. A shocking loss.​ Raw locker room talk. Go behind the scenes into their reality as Samurai​ Japan's camera keeps rolling.

title: Insects – Hidden Heroes
overview: How did our world come into being? Beneath our feet lies a class of animals far more numerous than any other. Let us embark on a journey through time dating back 400 million years, and witness how scattered pieces fit together to form a complete whole. Insects – Hidden Heroes takes us into the microcosm with stunning visuals. Narrated by screen icon Katharina Thalbach, the film poses a question: Must it be humanity or nature?

title: Josh Johnson: Symphony
overview: In his first HBO comedy special, comedian Josh Johnson debuts original material about our shared experiences as humans – tackling topics like family, religion, and relationships through his unique point of view and signature creativity.

title: Love Live! Hasunosora Girls' High School Idol Club Bloom Garden Party
ENHYPEN: IMMERSION IN CINEMAS
overview: A groundbreaking VR concert experience to theaters, showcasing a virtual, intimate performance featuring hits like "Bite Me" and "XO (Only If You Say Yes)" in special formats including ScreenX, 4DX, and Ultra 4DX for an immersive, 360-degree experience.
trailerName: 𝐄𝐍𝐇𝐘𝐏𝐄𝐍 𝐕𝐑 𝐂𝐎𝐍𝐂𝐄𝐑𝐓 : 𝐈𝐌𝐌𝐄𝐑𝐒𝐈𝐎𝐍 | Teaser Trailer | Coming to GSC LaLaport BBCC this 29 January

title: What Is To Come
overview: After unexpectedly losing her husband, Yehudit has no choice but to start over. In the process, she finds that abrupt and painful detours can lead to bright roads.

title: Turn It Up!
overview: An indie rock band struggling to make its mark finds a possible meal ticket in an infectious new guitar riff. Unfortunately, it’s also a cursed melody that just so happens to open a portal to another, much scarier dimension.

title: The A-Word: The Future of Aging
overview: Modern medicine treats diseases one-by-one, but what if aging itself is the root cause? The A-Word: The Future of Aging follows visionary scientists racing to extend lifespan and the rescue dog whose bond with an 87-year-old widower demonstrates the stakes of life extension.

title: Born Melo
overview: This new, official documentary takes an intimate look into the life and legacy of Carmelo Anthony as he is inducted into the Hall of Fame and sees his son, Kiyan, launch his collegiate basketball career.

title: Chris & Martina: The Final Set
overview: Tennis legends Chris Evert and Martina Navratilova reflect on their parallel journeys to sports stardom while delving into their rivalry and friendship, especially as the duo continue to support each other through their shared experience of cancer treatment.

title: ママがもうこの世界にいなくても　私の命の日記
overview: A terminally ill woman chooses to have a child and spends her final days embracing motherhood with courage and love.

title: Sara Bareilles: Good Grief
overview: Seven years after her Grammy Award-winning Amidst the Chaos, Sara Bareilles reunites with her closest collaborators to record a new album. What emerges is an intimate, cinematic process that lays bare the musician's deep connections and inspirations in  Josh Alexander's moving music documentary.

title: Forever, This Ring
overview: Maveric Collins, a successful entrepreneur and playboy, has promised to never get married — until he meets the woman of his dreams and changes his mind. But when they get married, he finds out she’s actually not who he thought she was. “Will the woman he once loved go away calmly, or will this end in a deadly divorce?”

title: March Forth
overview: This documentary is a powerful exploration into the life of Reginald Dwayne Betts, Yale Law School graduate and award-winning author, who transformed his time in prison into purpose.

title: Stealing Magic
overview: Someone is stealing the secrets behind magicians' greatest tricks and selling them on illicit websites. Magician Andi Gladwin leads an unlikely team of illusionists on an international caper to track down the culprits.

title: Ephemera
overview: In post-pandemic Shanghai, two women — one leaving, one staying — share a single electric night wandering the city. A tender, breezy queer love story where chemistry, connection and bittersweet goodbyes feel thrillingly alive.

title: Kingston
overview: On the illustrious campus of Kingston College, prestige drips off students, faculty and architecture. Amid social turmoil, three intertwining tales of disillusioned misfits collide under the machinations of an all-seeing institution.

title: Ensemble Modern – Why We Play
overview: The film goes far beyond the concert stage and delves into the tension-filled space of rehearsals – where the sound is not yet fixed, but alive, fragile, and in the process of becoming. We experience a wealth of musical encounters in which a shared musical language begins to breathe. The focus is on works by influential composers such as Rebecca Saunders, Heiner Goebbels, and Mark Andre, alongside the vibrant voices of a younger generation, including Brigitta Muntendorf and Milica Djordjevic, in collaboration with conductors such as Vimbayi Kaziboni, Bas Wiegers, Ingo Metzmacher, and Enno Poppe. Each year, Ensemble Modern premieres around 70 works, continually venturing into uncharted sonic territories.

title: Wacken - Hearts Full of Metal
overview: Mud, power outages, heavy rain – and yet Wacken draws crowds every year. For over three decades, Wacken Open Air has stood for friendship, perseverance, and a tight-knit community. With metal legends such as Kreator, Doro Pesch, and Motörhead, Wacken turns into an exceptional event – and a home away from home for fans from all over the world.

title: Every Now and Then, I Fall Apart
overview: Haunted by her best friend’s overdose, Eden numbs her grief through fleeting intimacy and quiet self-destruction. A sudden call from God pulls her back to the site of the death, where she’s offered a choice that forces her to confront what she’s been avoiding—and what she’s willing to destroy.
trailerName: every now and then, i fall apart

title: Father, Son and the Price of Resistance
overview: The father fought against the dictatorship in East Germany using his typewriter. His son took active measures. Two forms of resistance and an abyss of silence. Götz Schauder uses video messages to build a bridge between the two men. A painful struggle for the truth begins.

title: Hundertzwölf
overview: Who picks up when you dial 112? In Berlin, it’s the staff at the fire department’s massive emergency call center. Newcomers are finding their way or giving up, while veterans provide support from the background. Anything can happen at any moment. And then New Year’s Eve arrives.

title: Sterben für Anfänger
overview: As renowned science journalist Kurt Langbein is diagnosed with ‘terminal cancer’, a professional topic becomes an existential question: how do we die – and what does it actually mean to die? In his deeply personal documentary film, Langbein embarks on a journey to the boundary between life and death.

title: Helene Weigel - Revolutionärin im Rampenlicht
overview: Who was Helene Weigel? Using impressive archive material, the film follows the convinced communist, acting icon, and free spirit from her early days in theater to her escape from the Nazi regime to the founding and management of the Berliner Ensemble. The result is a powerful portrait that finally puts the “woman at Brecht's side” in the spotlight.

title: French Girls
overview: A young woman enters the uniquely absurd world of modelling in this Sydney microbudget marvel. The debut feature of Hyun Lee.  Mia is drifting through life working on construction sites when she’s scouted by a Sydney model agent. Suddenly, she’s making more money than ever while working less – something her boyfriend loves to point out. Mia quietly observes this strange new world of modelling with deep uncertainty. Is this really the life she wants? With one curious turn after another, she finds herself in trouble with the law.

title: Forks
overview: A group of gangsters who notoriously kill with forks struggle in the aftermath of a failed illegal deal.

title: NYRA II
overview: Trapped in a series of looping dream timelines, Nyra is hunted by an unknown killer and must find a way to escape before the cycles consume her.

title: Time Warp
overview: 50 years after “The Rocky Horror Picture Show” electrified audiences, a drag theater company in the once-booming mining town of Rock Springs, Wyoming, stages a shadow cast of the cult classic. Led by the charismatic 25-year-old performer Kenny Starling, the determined troupe spotlights the ongoing fight for queer visibility and acceptance in their community.

title: Documentary Enzo9000: The History
overview: An intimate documentary exploring the journey of Enzo Lemes Farias, professionally known as Enzo9000. The film traces his path from early content creation in Mauá to becoming a prominent and occasionally controversial figure in the Brazilian indie horror scene. Through narrative sagas of games like Five Nights at Freddy’s and Undertale, the documentary reveals the challenges of early fame, the resilience against digital harassment, and the profound artistic and personal transformation of this young digital filmmaker.

title: Winter in Prostokvashino
overview: Sequel to feature film adaptation of "Prostokvashino" by K.B.A.

title: KSonic: Into the Multi-World
overview: A YouTuber by the name KSonic28 has to outrun Copyright across the multiverse after being copyrighted by uploading AI content. (Made in Minecraft)

title: Back to the 90s
overview: Since childhood, five best friends have dreamed of making it big as a boy band. When a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity arises to take a step closer to realizing their musical dream, one band member suddenly wants to give it all up, putting the future of the entire group in jeopardy. The five guys have to rise to the occasion - and in doing so, they suddenly find themselves in a completely different decade.

title: Return to a Strange Land
overview: In this nostalgic and yet dramatic documentary, choreographer Jiří Kylián creates a final work for his lifelong partner Sabine, a deeply personal performance that celebrates love, creation, and the ephemeral nature of life.

title: Harvest
overview: Sondheimer, Louisiana. Population 200. Tucked in the northeast corner of the state, this rural enclave is home to the four Nelson Brothers—young, ambitious, fourth-generation commodity farmers who dream of becoming the biggest farmers in the United States.

title: Kids Like Me
overview: Explores the life and aspirations of Oliver, a rambunctious and imaginative preteen growing up with disabilities, who’s an avowed murder-mystery aficionado about to craft the perfect mystery caper.

title: Black Holes Suck
overview: After cracking his formula for unlimited energy, Cal, a lonely genius unknowingly agrees to a date with an Alien who's true motives lies in obtaining his formula before it can be used to wreak havoc amongst the Stars

title: Under the City Lights
overview: The story of two friends, a boy and a girl, finding more about each other during their long walks around Rome.

title: Stand Up
overview: Vera is a fun-loving 23-year-old until her entire life is upended after an accident leaves her in a wheelchair. Struggling to cope with her new reality, she meets Xander, who helps to show her that being in a wheelchair doesn’t mean she’s stuck.

title: Full Circle: The First All Black Everest Ascent
overview: An all-Black team sets out to summit Mount Everest not just to make history, but to redefine what it means to climb and who belongs in the mountains.

title: Guggi
overview: An intimate portrait of abstract painter Guggi that traces his journey from humble Irish beginnings—with friends Bono and Gavin Friday—through his post-punk phase and toward international acclaim as an uncompromising artist.

title: How to Feed a Dictator
overview: Five private chefs to fearsome dictators all over the world share their experiences of the kitchens and circumstances that led them to these sometimes dangerous and often morally compromising workplaces.

title: TikTok Never Dies
overview: When TikTok faces a nationwide ban, three influencers fight for their livelihoods, their voices, and the First Amendment. As their efforts advance to the Supreme Court, questions swirl around the stakes, power, and control of the future of social media.

title: American Zoo
overview: The Catskill Game Farm was America's first ever private zoo, fostering beloved childhood memories for a generation before falling into disrepair and closing in 2006. Amongst the rubble, filmmakers discover reels of home movies which would expose a shocking new chapter of the zoo's history.

title: The Gymnasts of Fisherman Colony
overview: The birth of a gymnastics team in Pakistan provides an inspiring spark of light for a small group of girls on the margins.

title: Jail Time Records
overview: The rivetingly intimate Jail Time Records profiles the first prison recording studio on the African continent and three incarcerated artists who express themselves through music.

title: Mexicanamerican
overview: Expertly merging old VHS home movies with new family interviews, filmmaker Eddie Sánchez traces his parents' journey from Mexico to the U.S. in this poignant and affecting documentary debut.
trailerName: Mexicanamerican | Official Trailer | Tribeca Festival World Premiere 2026

title: Retrieval
overview: If science allowed you to hold onto a piece of someone you lost, would you? When Christina’s fiancé dies suddenly, she faces the unexpected decision of whether or not to carry on his legacy via postmortem sperm retrieval.

title: Matininó
overview: A multi-generational family of outspoken Puerto Rican women takes center stage as they conceive and perform fantastical film vignettes as a way to navigate painful pasts in this visually-arresting, kaleidoscopic documentary.

title: The Haunting of Pennhurst
overview: Once a notorious institution for people with disabilities, Pennhurst finally closed after decades of abuse in 1987. Now those doors are reopening, as a group of disabled performers reframe the narrative around the site's harmful history – as a haunted house.

title: LE SSERAFIM VR CONCERT : INVITATION
overview: A virtual reality concert experience featuring LE SSERAFIM, offering an immersive and intimate performance that brings viewers closer than ever to the group through cutting-edge VR technology.

title: Goodbye Eri The Fan Film Live Action
overview: Yago, following a personal request from his ailing mother, begins to document his life through recordings. This film project takes an unexpected turn when it becomes intertwined with a mysterious figure named Eri, exploring the fine line between reality and fiction whilst grappling with grief and artistic creation.

title: Less Unhappy
overview: A gay man and a lesbian who are kicked out of the queer community for their toxicity and decide to try living as a straight couple, on the theory that straight people are dumb and therefore less miserable than smarter gay people.

title: i don't need a job
overview: A man ventures deeper and deeper into insanity due to the cost of AI automation and modern day internet culture.

title: Iris Replica
overview: A Puzzle. Triplets are celebrating their birthday. Two are waiting for the return of the third. What they don't know is that the voice outside the door doesn't belong to their brother.

title: DON'T
overview: Based on a true story, this short animated film illustrating the difficulties faced by a person suffering from mental illness. This black and white film, inspired by the classic style of sequencing, is animated using rotoscoping to convey realistic emotions and movements.

title: Licence
overview: A fruit vendor, denied a gun licence due to his low status, stages a fake attack with his friends to get around the system. But as the investigation deepens, it reveals a darker, deeply personal motive tied to his past.

title: Snared
overview: Join us on a journey around Auckland oceans and beaches, uncovering the impacts of fisheries on ocean ecosystems in New Zealand. Discover the balance we need to protect ocean life and appreciate the beauty of our marine life.

title: Hamilton House
overview: A home of struggling actors will stop at nothing to create a haunted house to catch the eye of their new neighbor, a legendary horror filmmaker.

title: THE ORIGIN OF ULTRAMAN
overview: The landmark Japanese Tokusatsu TV series Ultraman became a massive social phenomenon upon its debut in 1966, reaching a staggering peak viewership rating of 42.8%. Six decades later, Tsuburaya Productions continues to introduce new entries into the Ultraman series, expanding its unique universe to a global audience across generations. This documentary brings together leading voices from the fields of cinema, Tokusatsu, and design. Witness profound testimonies from an international assembly of creators, including: Guillermo del Toro, Hirokazu Kore-eda, Hideo Kojima, Hideaki Anno, Shinji Higuchi, and Nicolas Winding Refn.
trailerName: 『THE ORIGIN OF ULTRAMAN』本予告【7月3日(金)公開】

title: The Idiot
overview: The film IDIOT is a story of two completely different young men. Rene and Emil are brought together by their desire to get something from each other's world. As if without making any promises, they suddenly find themselves in situations where it seems that the only way out is to escape.  Emil, who seems to have been given everything in life, continues to disappoint his father and overcomes all the limits of suffering. Now he is faced with a life where he has to take responsibility for everything himself. He meets Rene, from whom Emil decides that he wants to learn a lot. Rene, however, tries to keep him away from mistakes that he can no longer fix himself, but he cannot remain confident enough.  Everything starts to develop too quickly and, despite Rene's warnings, Emil ends up turning the situation against both of them. They still have to work together to find a solution. Fear has overcome the boys.

title: The Gate of Murder
overview: Kazuyuki Tajima strikes up a friendship with his elementary school classmate, Osamu Kuramochi. From that moment on, a dark shadow begins to fall over his life. Following his grandmother's death, his parents divorce, and a rumor drives him out of his hometown. Each time he attempts to start over, Kuramochi reappears in his life.
trailerName: 映画『殺人の門』超特報映像【2027年2月19日公開】

title: 4000 Days
overview: Chronicles the relentless fight of three families—Gary and Julie DeVercelly, Linda and Eric Oakes, and TJ and Kim Burch—who turned their personal tragedies into a nationwide movement for change. After losing their sons to fraternity hazing, the families found themselves up against a deeply entrenched system that thrived on secrecy, denial, and silence. Refusing to accept that their children died in vain, they joined forces and waged a years-long battle to expose the dangers of hazing, challenge university and fraternity accountability, and push for sweeping legislative reform.

title: Secret of Kalinga
overview: A college sits on ancient Kalinga kingdom land. Behind it, a forest well holds a princess's spirit, imprisoned centuries ago. Students accidentally break the seal on New Year's Eve, triggering comedic chaos.
trailerName: SECRET OF KALINGA |Malayalam Movie Teaser | Dhyan Sreenivasan| Althaf Salim | Saneesh Unnikrishnan

title: Paroxysm
overview: After a drug deal goes horribly wrong, Celia is pulled into a surreal odyssey of self-discovery. Drifting through a distorted world, she encounters temptation, desire, and paranoia as her sense of self begins to unravel and the line between reality and fantasy begin to blur around her

title: El Renacer Albirrojo
overview: After 15 years of World Cup absences and social disillusionment, the arrival of a new coach sparks a run of improbable victories that ignite a glimmer of hope. "Renacer Albirrojo" is not just the chronicle of a qualification; it is the intimate portrait of a nation regaining its self-esteem through a team willing to give their all to achieve a long-postponed dream.

title: Talos
overview: In a time of loneliness, a father finds peace through his love for his daughter.

title: Match Monde
overview: People who connect through the Match-to-Match app get into street fights in the hope of earning cash and fame. Kagome Mahiro, an 18-year-old school dropout, rescues Mikio, a highschooler who is being harassed by a group of delinquants who use the app. Soon the two become embroiled in a fierce battle.

title: Jazz Suave
overview: Amid the frenetic pace of New York City, a group of young musicians confronts the paradox of pursuing a professional career in the world of jazz while struggling for economic survival. Their experience highlights how, at times, artistic life and financial stability appear to follow irreconcilable paths.

title: Sigma Males
overview: Two self-proclaimed "sigma males" go on the run for one wild night after doing an unspeakable act they can never come back from.

title: KillTonyMania
overview: Kill Tony tag teams with WrestleMania 42, as Tony Hinchcliffe, WWE icons and comedy heavyweights put upstart stand-ups to the test in Las Vegas.

title: The Cage
overview: Scotty, a struggling actor who faces constant rejection, receives a role in a short film, portraying a mentally troubled man. Scotty immerses himself in drastic preparation and isolation, and he finds himself losing his authenticity, slipping into different personalities, even when the cameras aren't rolling, unable to differentiate what his true reality is.

title: The 51st AFI Life Achievement Award: A Tribute to Eddie Murphy
overview: Follows the 51st AFI Life Achievement Award ceremony honoring Eddie Murphy for his five-decade career in film, television and stand-up comedy.

title: Abandonados
overview: Abandonados, a case by Carles Porta, revisits one of the most unsettling episodes in recent Spanish history. Forty years after being abandoned at a train station in Barcelona, three siblings embark on an investigation to uncover their identity and their past. Through testimonies, archival material, and a long-term investigation, the work reflects on memory, identity, and the search for truth.

title: When I Said I Do
overview: Ali Corley is a widowed search-and-rescue K-9 handler who rebuilt her life after losing her husband in the line of duty. When she meets seasoned rescue specialist Shawn Willis, their connection forces them both to confront the true meaning of commitment.

title: Believers
overview: A ragtag amateur cricket team from the UK tours The Gambia to face a national side far beyond their level. As losses mount and bonds deepen, they discover what the game truly means to them.

title: The Gaze of Sisyphus
overview: A university student investigates the truth behind a high school incident. As testimonies and rumors collide, the truth begins to blur, and her own past actions come into question. A youth suspense drama exploring collective psychology shaped by cycles of spread and conformity.

title: Land of No Man
overview: A loner capybara is questioned by passer-by animals: aren't you lonely?

title: Wait Offshore
overview: "Colleagues who started at the same time as you" - something that seems special but is actually known by many people. A bond that is neither friendship nor romantic love, but trust. A coming-of-age work movie set in Fukuoka, filled with tears, hardships, and conflicts as rookie office workers!

title: Couture to the Max

title: In illo αTempore
overview: 19th part (R. 19 bis) of interdisciplinary cycle REQUIEM. "I imagine that almost everyone who has come across this piece is familiar with the phrase 'in illo tempore'. In illo tempore—in that time. [...] Let’s pause for a moment on 'tempore'. Let’s consider, as laypeople might, what part of the original phrase this is. Of course, it is technically 'time.' [..] When an extra letter 'a' appeared in my mind—which has a tendency to complicate all sorts of concepts to the limit—it completely changed the perspective of everything. 'aTempore' was born. What did that mean to me? If 'tempore' is, theoretically, '(at) that time,' then 'aTempore' would mean 'non-time.' Now we have 'That Non-Time.' Does this mean we should think of time that has stopped? Or perhaps of different spaces, sensations? [...]" - as the introductionary note to the movie says.

title: The Freedom Fighters
overview: An unlikely group of neighbors decide to fight back against their tyrannical HOA president.

title: Sacrée soirée !
overview: Alban, a confirmed bachelor who no longer believes in love, sees his life turned upside down when he falls for Laetitia, his new neighbor... But the unexpected arrival of his childhood friend Samy, and the interventions of the building manager, throw what was supposed to be a perfect evening into chaos. Filmed on March 18, 2026, at the Théâtre de La Grande Comédie in Paris's 9th arrondissement.

title: A Message
overview: A Message is a short-form documentary draft capturing the raw, unmediated protests and performances of queer Palestinian artist Mama Ganuush while facing pink washing propaganda. Created by trans Palestinian artist Mama Ganuush, this film rejects the flattening narrative of tragedy. Instead, it posits Palestinian Futurism - a framework where those in exile are not merely survivors, but the architects of a liberated cultural and political future.

title: Razor
overview: When a little girl is hunted to be killed by a powerful politician and his ruthless criminal network, an unassuming dog groomer becomes her guardian angel as her fate dangles between survival and certain death.
trailerName: Razor Movie Trailer | Ravi Babu | Inaya Sultana | Meena Vasu | Taneesh | Premieres On 19th June |Aha

title: One Night
overview: One Night is a slice-of-life look at dating in your twenties. Margaret (Rain Spencer, "The Summer I Turned Pretty") and Will (Jackson Kelly, "The Pitt") are two college students navigating the messy, magnetic space between friendship and flirtation.

title: Melpomène
overview: Marthe discovers her mother’s death was a suicide, not an accident. At the hospital where she was once institutionalized, Marthe investigates the past—unraveling family secrets and facing a disturbing truth that threatens her grip on reality.

title: LOS PIJOS NO SABEN BAILAR
overview: A group of delinquents from the outskirts of Barcelona leave their neighborhood for the first time and discover a completely different world. What seemed like an adventure soon turns into a clash with a reality they did not expect.

title: Scissors

title: Hayok
overview: A feisty thriller about a fiercely independent woman who becomes the obsession of a contractor desperate to possess her. But when betrayal turns violent, she strikes back with a revenge that destroys his pride and control.
trailerName: Hayok Official Trailer | VMX | Apphle Celso, Stephanie Raz, Nico Locco, Chester Grecia

title: Star Wars: Heir to the Empire
overview: The Rebel Alliance has destroyed the Death Star, defeated Darth Vader and the Emperor, and driven the remnants of the old Imperial Starfleet to a distant corner of the galaxy. Princess Leia and Han Solo are married and expecting Jedi twins. And Luke Skywalker has become the first in a long-awaited line of Jedi Knights. But thousands of light-years away, the last of the Emperor's warlords has taken command of the shattered Imperial fleet, readied it for war, and pointed it at the fragile heart of the New Republic....
trailerName: Star Wars: Heir to the Empire - Full Trailer - Special Edition (Fan Animation)

title: Making Life on Earth: Attenborough’s Greatest Adventure
overview: In 1976, David Attenborough embarked on the most ambitious television series he had ever attempted. This is the hair-raising story of how the first wildlife blockbuster was born.

title: Chronically Yours
overview: Chronically Yours follows Aubrey, a 27-year-old living with Multiple Sclerosis and how that affects her dating life.

title: The Bruiser
overview: A disgraced underground fighter, Benny, chases redemption while confronting the damage he’s done—both in the cage and at home—before he loses everything for good.

title: The Nameless Season
overview: Do-wan grows increasingly anxious, afraid that he and Jae-yul, the boy he has secretly loved for years, will drift apart after graduation. After years apart, the two meet again by chance, and Do-wan realizes that the moment has come to finally confront his feelings.

overview: In this sequel to DONOVAN 17: THE WEEKEND WARS, after the clones, created by the Alien Surf Dude, questioned the purposes given to them, they decided to return to space, however, with The Brilliant Brick still lost in space, the few clones left must wait, uncertain whether to stay on Earth or go to space... These clones are the night clones... but are they the right clones?

title: Ramon's Revenge
overview: A young boy stumbles across a deserted stash of cocaine.

title: What Am I Looking At? Is It Someone’s Navel?
overview: While attempting to record life as it was, Arthur unintentionally documents his family’s unraveling.

title: American Prometheus
overview: A look into the eyes of the man who changed the world. This is the pain of the "American Prometheus" a man haunted by his own creation.

title: The Roots
overview: After a decade in Canada, a Bangladeshi immigrant Akash returns to Bangladesh with his child, seeking to reconnect with his abandoned family and past. But time has reshaped everything—relationships have faded, and home feels distant. Struggling with identity and belonging, he confronts the silent weight of migration and the ache of return. Feature Film ‘The Roots’ is a poignant exploration of identity, nostalgia, loss, and the search for home across two worlds.

title: Me, Myself, and Mary
overview: Chris O'Dowd and Aisling Bea star in the viral, true story of Séamas O'Reilly, who got his days mixed up and ended up alone with his boss and the President of Ireland while high on drugs.

overview: A broke Korean American student walks into a KPOP themed smoothie store and unknowingly orders a overpriced smoothie.

title: Never Fade
overview: Never Fade is a multi-dimensional creative project led by Thai actress Yoko Apasra Lertprasert, best known for her role in the Girls' Love (GL) series Blank. It serves as a personal brand and production house launched after her departure from NineStar Studios. The film is expected to explore emotional themes of resilience.

title: Beyond Yesterday
overview: After seeing his past flash before his eyes, a man named Robby dives deep into his memories as he tries to escape his emotions and tries to look beyond yesterday.
trailerName: Beyond Yesterday Official Trailer | A Short Film

title: Abuela,
overview: An intimate, investigative documentary retracing the life of Maria Jesús Echevarría. A brilliant, overlooked Spanish writer whose story was shaped by the wrong time, the wrong systems, and the right words.

title: The Dating App Nightmare
overview: Single mom Kate signs up for a dating app with her daughter Sarah, turning it into a fun bonding moment. But the fun ends fast when Sarah goes missing after a date with someone she met on the app. With little help, Kate launches her own search.

title: LOVE BITES
overview: Dina, a shy and awkward artist who is waiting for Jen, a loud and sporty jock, to arrive at the art gallery they are going to have their first date. First dates can be hard, but not as hard as the end of the world. While they are enjoying their evening, the unthinkable happens, the dead have started to rise and have the potential to ruin the night. Can Dina and Jen battle the dead and make it to a second date?

title: Kyle Larson vs. The Double
overview: Two-time NASCAR champion Kyle Larson attempts the notorious "Double," racing the Indianapolis 500 and the Coca-Cola 600 on the same day. With weather, exhaustion, and risk closing in, 1,100 miles offers a rare inside look at one of the toughest challenges in motorsports-and the man daring enough to take it on.

title: Ghost of Ueno
overview: In 2023, over 80,000 people went missing in Japan, with 30,000 dying alone. Ten percent remained unidentified, known as “muenbotoke” (buddhas without connections).  Satsuki works part-time at an NGO near Ueno Park, indifferent to her job and the faces of those seeking help, until she stumbles upon the diary of a deceased homeless man. Toshi, a fellow drifter in the park, tells her that her encounter with the man’s ghost is no accident. Guided by the diary, they embark on a journey into the past to uncover the man’s identity, which is deeply intertwined with Ueno’s post-war history. Along the way, they meet those whose lives the ghost touched, each revealing a story of a man who willingly cut ties with his family. Satsuki’s dreams and memories lead her astray, uncovering a bitter truth. Her search for answers about the vanished finds resolution in Toshi, who waits for the third reincarnation of his late wife.

title: The 10th House
overview: After the mysterious death of his father inside their newly built house, Nguyễn Văn Ân lives with his mentally deteriorating mother as a series of unsettling supernatural events begin to unfold. In an attempt to uncover the truth, Ân starts documenting everything through a vlog series titled Spiritual Stories in My House (Chuyện tâm linh trong nhà mình). During his investigation, he discovers an ancient talisman buried beneath the foundation and gradually realizes that the house is connected to a Lu Ban curse ritual passed down among construction workers — tied to a rumor that after nine ordinary houses, a mysterious “tenth house” is chosen for a dark purpose never meant to be revealed.

title: Dua Nafas
overview: Anto was entrusted to his grandmother in the village, grew up to become a successful doctor, and then returned to make her proud—only to find that his grandmother had died while waiting for him.

title: A Kindness
overview: After fleeing a blood-soaked nightmare in the woods, a priest seeks shelter in the home of a kind suburban woman.

title: We Loved You, Now
overview: An Armenian funeral meal takes an unexpected turn.

title: Gary
overview: Two friends go on a work trip and encounter unexpected challenges and local personalities as they navigate their assignment. Their efforts to adapt to unfamiliar surroundings highlights moments of humor, small-town culture and the unpredictable nature of work travel. As they troubleshoot problems, their experience leaves a lasting impression and offers new perspectives on their friendship.

title: 1995 - Hopes and Betrayals
overview: In 1995, Quebec faced a harrowing choice: remain part of Canada or establish itself as a separate country. The future of a nation and a lifelong dream were at stake in this referendum. Through interviews and analysis, journalists Antoine Robitaille and Dave Noël delve into the secret strategies, fierce rivalries, and political maneuvering of both sides.

title: INDEPENDIENTE
overview: Three Mexican filmmakers — Max del Río, Gabriela Ivette Sandoval, and Hugo Villaseñor Alcázar — share their processes and challenges around a single question: How can an independent film get seen? Through the eyes of insiders, the documentary reveals the complex journey behind making cinema visible in Mexico.

title: டே 11
overview: Five youngsters become addicted to a mysterious fantasy game that grants every wish instantly. As reality begins to blur, one girl suddenly disappears and is presumed dead. Realizing the game holds the truth, the others re-enter it to uncover its hidden rules.  They discover every wish comes at a cost and must make a painful sacrifice to bring her back forever changed by the consequences of their desires.

title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
overview: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

title: Midnight Knocks at the Door
overview: Stripped of color and clothes, ready to be cleansed. A young man's midnight bath becomes a surreal nightmare the moment he realizes he is not alone.
trailerName: Midnight Knocks at the Door | Official Teaser

title: A Holandesinha
overview: “A Holandesinha” follows Luiza Godoi Acosta, a young woman with Down syndrome who dreams of becoming a filmmaker and sets out to create her first short film, "Lágrimas de um Pierrot". The documentary traces every stage of the creative process, revealing her worldview, the challenges she faces, and her triumphs over ableism. Produced in the countryside of Paraná, the film celebrates inclusion and affirms cinema as a space of possibility, belonging, and perseverance.

title: Terrestrial Stars
overview: Miguel, 17, lives in a small town in the Brazilian countryside and dreams of becoming an actor. When he passes an audition in a big city, he is faced with the dilemma of leaving behind his home and his best friend, João. Miguel realizes that running away is easier than saying goodbye.

title: Las Vegas, Cuba
overview: In the future, a traveling android arrives in a deserted Havana in search of Las Vegas, a mythical cabaret founded by a guerrilla fighter.

title: Tornar-se Ciborgue no Interior
overview: Leo and Julia, owners of a rural property, want to have children but are facing fertility issues. Ava and Mia, a lesbian couple, have just moved to the neighboring property. The arrival of the two women will create tension with the neighbors.

title: Harvey & Maude
overview: For years, Maude has remained housebound, her home a refuge from a world that feels both hostile and alien. Meanwhile, Harvey —a long-forgotten imaginary friend— wanders aimlessly through a realm of the unremembered. Though worlds apart, their paths are destined to cross, and their lives begin to brighten as they realize that imagination hasn't faded quite yet.

title: Nostalgia for the Future
overview: Guided by the evocative narration of Charlotte Rampling, Nostalgia for the Future is a descent into the labyrinthine world of Chris Marker, the “best-known author of unknown films,” who spent a lifetime concealing himself behind a veil of pseudonyms and images of cats.  Moving through a constellation of personal documents and film fragments, an archivist attempts to decode the man through the material traces he left behind. By repurposing and recontextualizing Marker’s own body of work, the film treats his images as “time machines,” transforming the archive into a landscape of living memory. Nostalgia for the Future is a meditation on memory, identity, and the power our past images hold over the futures we imagine.
trailerName: NOSTALGIA FOR THE FUTURE | FESTIVAL TRAILER | ENG

title: My Coluche
overview: It’s the story of two guys — a comedian and a journalist — who become friends and get up to all sorts of antics. It’s the story of two men reflecting their era. It’s the story of one man, Coluche, seen through the eyes of his friend, Michel Denisot. It’s the story of his Coluche.

title: Vittorio De Sica: Staging Life
overview: A documentary feature film about Vittorio De Sica, one of the greatest masters of world cinema. Through a new access to his family, rare archives and testimonies of contemporary artists and filmmakers from the entire world, the ilm retraces his life, his work and legacy. An intimate portrait of an author able to transform the observation of the real in an universal emotion and reveals the modernity of a gaze which keeps on illuminating cinema and our way of seeing the world.

title: Dernsie: The Amazing Life of Bruce Dern
overview: DERNSIE is an intimate portrait of Bruce Dern—tireless, uncompromising, and one of the last living legends of his generation—whose endurance has shaped both a turbulent life and one of Hollywood’s most enduring careers. A relentless runner on and off screen, Dern has outlasted the very industry that defined him.

title: A menina que queria ser pedra
overview: A curious boy and a serene girl meet by the edge of a lake. There, reflections on life emerge in subtle and unexpected ways. After all, what does it mean to be a stone?

title: Aterro Zeitgeist
overview: A story about a strange island and its citizens with concrete heads, and a landfill where they believed they could rid themselves of their troubles—until a small clay carranca appears. A surreal tale about how every action has consequences.

title: Kika Não Foi Convidada
overview: A young girl discovers she is not welcome at a birthday party. As they learn the value of true friendship, children offer a lesson in empathy and inclusion.

title: Worse Than Death
overview: When an isolated woman attempts to escape from her abusive marriage, she must decide what her life and her faith really mean to her.

title: Nosso Tempero
overview: In a small village in the interior of Rio Grande do Norte, where cashews dominate the landscape, a girl born and raised there confesses that she hates the fruit. A film created as part of a filmmaking workshop from the Projeto Animação (IMA).
directors: Alunos e alunas da Escola Municipal João Victor

title: O Mez da Grippe

Amid immigrant voices, archival images, and echoes of a haunted city, the past returns as an enigma that refuses to fade.

title: Cerimônia

overview: Baby, a rising rock star, is tormented by a fever that prevents him from creating new music. When he receives a call from Pepeu, his former musical partner and ex-lover, they decide to compose one last song together — a melody of healing and resurrection to be performed on a night of a blood moon.

title: Born to Fly
overview: Born To Fly, directed and produced by Ali Khajeian, tells the story of dedication and perseverance through the eyes of Hong Kong born, Indian national, Melbourne-based Ultra Runner, Rahul Sharma, from running his first marathon to setting a world record all in the same year. Between 24th – 30th December 2025, Rahul became the first person ever to run the length of  Sri Lanka, setting a new world record for the fastest time to cover the 566km journey (completing the run in 6 days, 13hours and 22 minutes). The intricacies and procedures of this great feat, planned by the team of students that surround him are captured in this documentary and Born To Fly follows the story of Rahul and his team in making this dream a reality.

overview: What can 20 actors’ faces, waiting for a casting call, reveal?

title: Maxita

We follow him on a journey to Brumadinho, where he encounters the aftermath of the Brumadinho dam disaster. Between the earthly and the spiritual realms, his path intersects with the maxita watimapë—the “earth eaters” — and leads him to reunite with his longtime ally Ailton Krenak.

title: Olhe para Mim
overview: Marcelo’s mother disappeared when he was 10 years old, leaving him with an endless void. The boy grows into a young man who wanders through cemeteries and takes refuge in invented memories to cope with reality. One day, two mysterious beings cross his path, and Marcelo sets off with them on a journey across the boundaries between the world of the living and the world of the dead.

title: Reparação

During rehearsals, dreams, words, and ways of being emerge as fragile species to be preserved. As they perform, the group reflects on survival, belonging, and the ongoing preservation of their own community.

Although the authorities do not take the case seriously, the lieutenant suspects there is something deeper hidden, unaware that a macabre truth lies beneath.

title: Part-time Death Angel
overview: After his father's arrest shatters his once-stable life, college student Shinji falls into deep despair. One day, he is approached by his classmate Yuki, who invites him to join a strange part-time job—working as a "Death Angel." The job involves resolving the lingering regrets of the departed who cannot move on, and guiding them peacefully into the afterlife. Although skeptical at first, Shinji gradually regains hope as he helps each of the departed fulfill their final wish and pass on. Just as their part-time work seems to be going well, a secret Yuki has kept hidden is revealed, bringing an unexpected turn to their lives.

Over the course of the celebration, the three must confront what love, family, and responsibility mean for them.

title: Boss Cat

Dealing with early-twenties existential angst and a sense of responsibility for her teenage younger sister Emma, she has a lot on her plate. Suddenly under the care of her controlling grandma and—as a young woman living with Down syndrome—constantly faced with a society that judges what she’s capable of, Sonja is desperate to be herself and take charge of her own life. When a chance encounter with the charismatic Hakim leads her to a krump class, Sonja discovers a life-changing outlet for expression.

title: Because of you Ka Kui
overview: A documentary feature celebrating the music, life, and artistic pursuit of Canto rock music legend Wong Ka Kui, whose voice and vision defined the sound of Beyond- the most influential Canto rock band of all time. Featuring rare concert footage, never-before-seen archives of Ka Kui's early years, and unreleased work, this documentary offers an intimate portrait of Wong Ka Kui- not through nostalgia, not as a distant legend, but as he truly was. At its heart is the precious legacy of his character and convictions—one that continues to transcend generations, his music still lifting spirits and inspiring hope today.

title: The Hermit Crab
overview: The story follows Quân, a grieving husband devastated by the sudden death of his wife in a tragic accident. Like hermit crabs borrowing shells to survive, they cling to borrowed identities in an attempt to escape the pain of their lives. But their fragile happiness begins to unravel when a horrifying secret surrounding his wife’s death comes to light, forcing Quân to choose between clinging to the illusion of comfort or exposing the terrifying truth hidden beneath the shell he has created.

title: Keep The Faith
overview: Lorraine Carter lives a quiet, contemptuous life in the mundane suburbs of Lincoln. She is restless, discontented and dreams of what once was and what could have been. Having once lived on the road, gigging as the lead singer in a punk band, Lorraine was a real rock star, or came close to being one. With the band's burgeoning dreams being cut short, and life sweeping her forward, Lorraine's life as a proud punk-rocker seemed over. Swapping punk for a nine-to-five, and the microphone for motherhood, Lorraine watched from the margins as her life sped by. Beaten, forgotten, and belittled by the world around her, Lorraine grows tempestuous. She yearns to reclaim her creative identity, to express herself and to fight for what she believes in. She prepares to come to terms with her past, to overcome her fears, and to take the stage once again. With a microphone in hand, she sings a simple phrase. Keep the faith, it’s all we’ve got.

Mo Gawdat spent two years travelling the world - from Shanghai to Riyadh, New York to London - to find out, engaging with the leading minds shaping our future including Yoshua Bengio, Fei-Fei Li, Geoffrey Hinton, Max Tegmark, Elon Musk and Sam Altman. The result is a film that might change the way you see everything

title: Constantine the Great: Emperor of New Rome
overview: Constantine the Great, son of General Constantius Chlorus, rose to power during the Tetrarchy, a division of the Roman Empire among four emperors. After succeeding his father in 306 and being acknowledged as the sole Emperor of the West in 310, he enacted significant military, economic, and religious reforms that unified the empire. This documentary explores his life and reign, highlighting his role in ending the persecution of Christians and the transition from polytheistic beliefs. It also touches on his personal intrigues, including the murder of his concubine Fausta, showcasing his complex legacy of power and grandeur.

The film is denser. The imburanas de cambão burst into flames as the sertão turns into desert.

Madeira Palace (São Paulo), a well-known downtown hotel associated with chemsex encounters, receives a character immersed in delirium and confinement, confronted with his own duplication. Freely inspired by Campos de Carvalho. At Hotel Glória (Rio de Janeiro), the rise of a new real estate icon unfolds — because even ghosts are forced to update themselves.

It confronts colonial hangovers, societal silences, and the class and language divides that shape who gets to participate in the national conversation.

As she hunts the officer, dark truths unravel, leading to a gripping face-off between power, guilt, and justice.
trailerName: Bhishmar Official Trailer | East Coast Vijayan | Dhyan Sreenivasan| Vishnu Unnikrishnan|Divya Pillai

title: Strangers in the Mountain
overview: In the 1990s, two police officers ventured into the mountains along Zhejiang's Shanxi Stream to track down a suspect from an old case. As they dug deeper into the past, long-buried memories resurfaced, stirring poignant recollections among everyone involved about Zhang Xue, the person who had gone missing.

title: Cassowary
overview: Three generations of women — grandmother, mother and daughter — live in a house on a remote island. The grandmother remains silent all day long, while the mother drowns her sorrows in alcohol. The younger brother never truly grows up. The daughter Su Min chooses to leave and works as a bird scarer at an airport. After a fire breaks out at home, she returns to the island with tangled emotions. The arrival of a mysterious fire-eating bird shatters the long-standing peace, gradually unearthing the family’s long-buried secrets and repressed feelings.

title: Her First Taste
overview: Wen Yuwen, a cute and naive high school girl, loves Chinese far more than math. She tentatively steps into billiard halls, clothing stores and hotels — places of the adult world. She also begins to confront growing pains: relationships with the opposite sex, studying abroad, and her father’s infidelity. Confused yet brave at times, she embarks on a stumbling adventure of youth.

title: The Intervention
overview: A woman rushing home to meet a date is blindsided by an unexpected intervention from friends and family, only to discover her bewildered Hinge match has also been roped into it too.

title: UNBOUND
overview: A young woman, Elowyn, is thrown into the re-education centre for breaking the Marriage Act. She must endure Officer Killian’s brutal lessons at the centre and find hope in unlikely places, although her cellmate Hannah warns her to do nothing. When escape is not an option, how can Elowyn remain unbound?

title: Christine Bermas: All The Way
overview: Get to know the woman behind the daring roles as Christine Bermas opens up beyond the camera. From her dating style to behind-the-scenes stories and personal experiences in her most talked about films, this special reveals a more honest and intimate side of the actress.
trailerName: CHRISTINE BERMAS: ALL THE WAY Official Trailer | VMX | June 2

title: Anatomia do Caos
overview: With unprecedented access to the Brazilian Senate, director Dandara Ferreira follows the entire trajectory of the Covid-19 Parliamentary Inquiry from the inside, transforming this exclusive footage into a cinematic record of one of the most defining moments of the pandemic in Brazil.

title: Hate That I Made You Love Me
overview: Short film and music video for the lead single on Ariana Grande’s eighth studio album “Petal”

title: The War Game at Cinecity
overview: When Peter Watkins’ banned nuclear war masterpiece "The War Game" reached Toronto in 1967, it found an unlikely home at Cinecity, a new cinema determined to challenge audiences. Drawing on archival research and eyewitness accounts, this documentary explores the film’s enduring impact and the role Cinecity played in shaping Canadian film culture.

title: Aa Bata Aama 2
overview: Plot to be announced.

title: Instupendo: Live from the Backrooms
overview: Instupendo: live from the backrooms is a 2026 live DJ mix by Instupendo, inspired by the atmosphere and cultural impact of the Backrooms phenomenon. Blending ambient textures, electronic soundscapes, nostalgic melodies, and immersive transitions, the mix creates a continuous listening experience that reflects the dreamlike qualities often associated with Instupendo’s music. Drawing from themes of liminality, memory, and exploration, the project transforms familiar emotions into an expansive sonic journey. Released in connection with Backrooms-related promotional events, live from the backrooms highlights the strong connection between Instupendo’s work and the online communities that embrace ambient music, internet culture, and liminal-space aesthetics, offering listeners an atmospheric experience designed to be explored from beginning to end.

title: Slow & Stupendous
overview: Two friends go on an adventure to find a missing film in the Slow & Stupendous series.

title: Eclipse Town
overview: A short film from the video game.

title: The Call Center
overview: Three young professionals leading the government’s communications department make a critical mistake that jeopardizes the upcoming presidential election. To fix it, they must go to the very last extremes, even if it costs them their lives.

title: How to Generate a Perfect Crime
overview: After his sister, Sara, accidentally kills her threatening teacher in self-defense, Wataru makes a desperate decision to protect her. He uses an AI chatbot to generate a plan for the "perfect crime," staging the crime scene and covering up evidence based on the AI's instructions to make it look like a random homicide.

title: Man of War
overview: When an aid worker vanishes in the first hours of war in Ukraine, a former Navy SEAL and CIA operative crosses into the shattered country to bring her home-facing mercenaries, shifting battle lines, and ghosts he thought he left behind.

title: Redemptions
overview: Marcel, a retired hitman, is forced back into action and commits two murders in Montreal. In doing so, he unwittingly sets in motion a chain of unforeseen events that will ultimately endanger the life of his own daughter in Paris.

title: Fruitless
overview: Oscar, an aspiring fashion designer, is faced with a painful decision following the events of a turbulent night..

title: Romin
overview: When Romin discovers a lost object in the forest, he asks his friends to help him uncover the legend behind this mysterious object, while a grieving man seeks to use the artifact to bring his wife back.

title: Little Hearts: Madness of Love
overview: A broke, desperate filmmaker fakes a public proposal to chase online fame. It goes viral, turning into real love, real fallout, and a harsh choice feed the algorithm or protect his heart in a world where emotions are content, at any cost

title: Tinseltown
overview: A young struggling Actor meets a brief and unlikely mentor in attempting an impossible project.

title: Reverie in Reverse
overview: Time flows backward through the last moments of a man’s life, where gestures precede their meanings and emotions echo before they are felt. As the world rewinds around him, fragments of presence dissolve into silence, revealing a final truth hidden at the beginning of it all.

title: The Deliverer
overview: Facundo is an eccentric man with a variety of jobs and interests, but few people remember one of his greatest talents. After years of being sidelined in the industry, he receives a call with an offer he can’t refuse. He’ll become The Deliverer once again.

title: Curiosity Killed the Cat
overview: A struggling young writer finds inspiration when a package is delivered to the wrong address, leading her to discover and investigate her neighbour's dark secret.

title: Água Salgada
overview: With her partner lost at sea, a young woman begins to question her perception of reality and identity.

title: Toe Tags
overview: TOE TAGS – Feet as Fetish, Fragment, Ghost  From Phallacies, which stripped the male body of shame and censorship, to Analogies, exploring the taboo of the anus, Toe Tags steps into a new obsession: the foot.  Feet become fetish, memory, and horror: a woman inherits her mother’s shoes (CLARA), a transvestite searches for feet that fit (THE PERFECT PAIR), a child avenges his monstrous father (PODOPHILE), a schizophrenic confuses nail visions with reality (NAILS), a man dances one last time with his wife’s ghost (SHOES NUMBER 43), and a mermaid mourns the tail she abandoned (PART OF YOUR WORLD).  ToeTag – where obsession walks, steps, and sometimes, kills.
trailerName: Toe Tags Limited Edition Bluray Trailer (Dagon Films)

title: Groundskeeper
overview: It was supposed to be a fun weekend. A trip away for a close-knit friend group to celebrate the end of high school. But when their estranged former best friend shows up, unannounced, with her douche boyfriend in tow… plans change. Tensions rise, friendships are tested, and the whole weekend seems hopeless. As a last-ditch attempt to save the trip, the group revisits a game from their childhood, a game inspired by a local ghost story. What started out as a fun activity turns deadly as real life begins to mirror the actions of the game, leading the friends to question each other and their own judgement. After all, no one really believes in ghosts… right?

title: Girl Talk
overview: Over an extended period, a director engages in an ongoing conversation with Yu, a teenage girl trying to come out of her experience of sexual trauma. A dialogue built on trust, the film follows Yu as she gradually learns to assert herself while the director remains present and open in the process. Through her social encounters, her words, and the short films she makes, Yu reflects on how she has been seen and defined, and begins to reclaim control of her own story. Resisting the label of “victim,” she moves forward with a firm step into the world.

title: Coo Coo Quark Quark
overview: A group of young people born in or after 1995 from Hangzhou set out on a quest for a cherished item they lost in their childhood, a journey that unexpectedly changed their lives in the process.

title: Sihir Tanah Kubur
overview: After his mother's death, Yusuf is shocked when his younger brother, Ashar, moves her grave due to a mysterious will. The appearance of the Wurung Tomb triggers a mystical terror that divides the family and the villagers. Amidst the escalating conflict, dark family secrets are revealed, posing a demonic threat that jeopardizes their future.
trailerName: Grave Soil Sorcery - Official Trailer (Clean Version) | July 23, 2026 in Theaters

title: Anak-Anak Bambu
overview: Netta planned to sell the orphanage to solve her family's problems. However, after getting to know the orphans living there, especially Gebang, she realized that family isn't just about blood ties, but about caring for each other. This journey led Netta to discover the meaning of family that had been missing from her life.

title: Should to Shoulder
overview: A foreign writer is in Sicily and believes that careful observation is enough to understand Sicilian culture and Sicilians. However, through his stories, he learns that you cannot know or understand Sicily or Sicilians through mere observation. You have to stand beside its people, shoulder to shoulder (Spalla a Spadda), share their struggles and their victories. Only then can you begin to understand
trailerName: Spalla a Spadda (Trailer) - 72nd Edition of Taormina Film Festival

title: Ghost Buzzer: Antar Aku Pulang
overview: Four mystery-loving friends investigate a haunted basement and encounter the spirit of Maria, who begs for help returning home. Their mission leads them on an adventure filled with terror, puzzles, and friendship as they help the spirits find peace.
trailerName: Ghost Buzzer - Antar Aku Pulang - CINEMA 21 Trailer

title: PULSE
overview: A man isolated from society appears to have nothing to show for his life, yet in his solitude, he has quietly taught himself to see and hear the world with a depth and beauty that most people are too distracted to ever find.

title: Smile Charles
overview: An unknown actor from Korea, having lost everything after appearing in pornography, hides away as an online sex worker under the alias "Smile Charles." The painful gap between his inner emotions and his forced expressions breeds an unbearable awkwardness that severs him completely from the world. One day, Mari—a con artist who swindled 2 billion—pierces through the cracks of his isolated life. The uneasy companionship between the slick scammer and the awkward sex worker weaves through Bangkok's humid nights and Ayutthaya's silent ruins, leading Charles to confront the forgotten dreams and phantoms of his past.

title: The Robber
overview: After an incident in Seoul, a teenage boy with kleptomania transfers to a high school in a coastal town. He only wants to stay quiet until graduation, but his urges continue, and one day his own belongings disappear. Suspecting another thief, he begins following the class president. As she learns his secret too, the two become tied by each other’s weakness, until a stolen object reveals the hidden truth of a model student.

title: The Day I Stopped Walking
overview: When we stop we're so focused on productivity and efficiency that we feel guilty and confused about our own limitless time giving rise to a silent restlessness: the feeling that we should be producing, moving forward, and justifying every minute. With a new emerging force, the human being in its essence becomes increasingly scarce: we can no longer think, speak, and, above all, be. But ultimately, why does it have to be this way?

title: Ayman, Unscripted
overview: Not every experience leaves a trace, but some quietly change you, and you rarely know which until long after. Unscripted Ayman is a personal and reflective documentary that revisits one man's time in El Jadida, the people he met, the things he learned about himself, and the slow realization that meaning doesn't always show itself in the moment it's lived. It's a film about looking back and asking: was I simply passing through, or did it truly matter? A short poetic documentary by Framed in Marrakech. Watch here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cs6tzfmi0rg&t=96s
trailerName: Do you dare to ask yourself? Ayman, Unscripted | Official Trailer

title: Maxim Commodity Ballet
overview: A kaleidoscopic exploration of found objects that express deeper human emotion.

title: Saat Aku Bersuara
overview: Nadia, a bright young lawyer, finds her life shattered when her wedding is canceled at the last second. But that bitterness did not make him submit. She rose up and dedicated herself to defending women's rights. Together with her two friends, Andien and Riana, and Adrian, a Public Prosecutor who is an important part of her journey, Nadia struggles to rebuild her life, including her broken relationship with her father. As the wounds of the past slowly find their way, Nadia becomes increasingly convinced that as long as she dares to speak out and doesn't give up, hope will never be extinguished.

title: Welcome to Borovia
overview: Harry Enfield heads a brilliant cast in this quirky political comedy where plots, counterplots and seduction flourish in faraway Borovia.

title: Hindsight
overview: A socially anxious teen faces his ultimate boss battle: buying a video game. His overactive imagination turns a simple transaction into an epic disaster, proving that the real enemy is just awkward small talk.

title: Newspeak
overview: A man finds himself in a place he can't recognize, accused of a crime he can't remember, and when he's punished, he is sent to "the room" a mysterious place that takes away his  agency and makes him the face of this malicious place.

overview: An erotic thriller about Mara, a woman who seduces celebrities and influencers to secretly film and blackmail them for money. But when love enters the picture, her dangerous scheme begins to fall apart.
trailerName: SCANDAL QUEEN Official Trailer | World Premiere this June 5 only on VMX

title: The Killing
overview: A hitman receives a mysterious assignment to eliminate a target in a grassy field on the outskirts of town. Behind the seemingly simple mission lies dark motives, deep hatred, and a secret slowly coming to light.

title: Modem
overview: A digital detox vacation goes wrong when a teenager discovers a MODEM.

title: Roberto Zucco
overview: One night, Roberto Zucco escapes from the prison where he was incarcerated for the murder of his father. Thus begins a dizzying escape, punctuated by encounters that illustrate a quest for identity.

title: PAPER ANGELS
overview: Mikey Mendoza rises through pro skateboarding and sustainable fashion design to carve out his new identity, despite capitalist and societal forces, leaving his tumultuous childhood in the dust.

title: Controlled: Can I Trust My Partner?
overview: Daisy Maskell investigates the shocking surge in partner abuse among under-30s, and enlists her boyfriend to help her expose the sinister ‘stalkerware’ apps used to spy on victims.

title: IN VERTIGO - OG Keemo und Funkvater Frank
overview: OG Keemo faces his demons: An intense documentary about music, mental health, fatherhood, and a new album.
trailerName: IN VERTIGO - OG Keemo und Funkvater Frank (Trailer)

title: Game Face

title: The Sacrifice
overview: In a brutal dystopian society, a new life can only be created by sacrificing another. In the final hours before the birth, Lucas must secure his child's future - but does he have what it takes?

title: A Burial
overview: A struggling photographer’s life is upended when he receives the news of his wife’s pregnancy. As his mental state deteriorates he becomes increasingly violent and dangerous and he struggles desperately to hide a heinous crime while haunted by a mysterious stranger who knows too much. The pressure builds, and his relationships decay, until he must confront his own darkness, or become it.

title: Ages of Madness: The Howling of the Jinn
overview: A cosmic horror animated movie.

title: Two Hornets
overview: An independent Slovak queer horror drama following themes of self-discovery and dark tension. Directed and written by filmmaker Dominik György, the film blends atmospheric psychological drama with horror elements against local forest settings.

title: Stone Lions Don't Roar
overview: In a world where one's emotions manifest as a living beast, two orphaned sisters must reconcile their fraught relationship as they cross the militarily occupied countryside.
trailerName: STONE LIONS DON'T ROAR | Official Trailer

title: The Understudy
overview: A shy high school student, Sienna, tends to keep to herself and doesn't let anyone in. When she decides to audition for her school play she learns being on her own isn't always a good thing.

title: Sundown Syndrome
overview: A homeless eats a strange biscuit and begins to hallucinate; everything around him becomes an evil space.

title: Rotten Apples
overview: When Eddie, a successful but insecure actor, is saddled with his Alzheimer's-stricken father after he’s kicked out of Rotten Apples, a nursing home for emotionally inept old men, he must figure out the fastest way to get rid of him—in time for his life-changing Zoom audition with Darren Aronofsky, a role which could finally get him the Award he has always dreamed of.

title: Salitre no more
overview: For around fifteen years, I have been filming a forest of imburana de cambão trees that has been progressively disappearing, located on the border between the states of Bahia and Pernambuco. The visual saturation created through image overlaps and the division of the screen into three parts fosters the emergence of a particular rhythm, in which pulsating texts impose other forms of escape.The gradual disappearance of this forest echoes texts evoking the consequences of climate change, while also inscribing fire and logging as human acts contributing to this impoverishment.The basis of this film was the installation of the same name presented as part of an exhibition at the Frans Krajcberg Space in 2025. The film is denser. The imburanas de cambão burst into flames as the sertão turns into desert.

title: Lavender
overview: When lesbian writer Audrey runs into her ex-boyfriend, Julian, she must confront her bisexual panic or risk losing her sense of identity.

title: Expert Marksmanship: A Path to Olympic Gold Medal
overview: This 1962 unclassified documentary short features footage of Captain W. W. McMillan's marksmanship skills, and his "Path to Olympic Gold Medal" at the 1960 Olympics.  While depicting Marines caring for rifles and practicing marksmanship at large shooting ranges, the majority of the film focuses on an interview of McMillan, where he provides marksmanship instruction and demonstrates each step, focusing on fundamentals like grip, stance, stability, sighting alignment and trigger control for rapid fire shooting with pistols and revolvers.  The film also features footage of McMillan at the Olympics and multiple creative "trick shots" by McMillan: teacups, poker chips, playing cards, upside down pistol shots and slight aligning with mirrors.

title: Mother
overview: A letter brings a young woman's grief to the surface, reconnecting her with Somalia and her lost birth mother. Starring Edyll Ismail (Send Help).

title: The Woods Run Red – The Making of “Hunter’s Blood”
